#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cassert>
#include <algorithm>

class Util {
public:
    static void ASSERT(bool assertion) {
        if (!assertion) {
            throw std::runtime_error("Assertion failed");
        }
    }
};

class IntStack {
public:
    std::vector<int> array;

    IntStack() {
        array.reserve(8);
    }

    void push(int item) {
        array.push_back(item);
    }

    int size() const {
        return array.size();
    }

    int get(int i) const {
        Util::ASSERT(i < array.size());
        return array[i];
    }

    void resize(size_t newCapacity) {
        array.reserve(newCapacity);
    }

    std::string toString() const {
        std::ostringstream oss;
        oss << "[";
        for (size_t i = 0; i < array.size(); ++i) {
            oss << array[i];
            if (i != array.size() - 1)
                oss << ", ";
        }
        oss << "]";
        return oss.str();
    }
};

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    protected:
        IntStack factorial;
        IntStack invFactorial;

    public:
        virtual long long modulus() const = 0;

        Modulus() {
            factorial.push(1);
            invFactorial.push(1);
        }

        long long fact(int n) {
            while ((int)factorial.size() <= n) {
                long long last_fact = factorial.get(factorial.size() - 1);
                factorial.push((int)(mult(last_fact, (long long)factorial.size())));
            }
            return factorial.get(n);
        }

        long long fInv(int n) {
            size_t lastKnown = invFactorial.size() - 1;
            if (lastKnown < n) {
                std::vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < (int)fInv.size(); ++i) {
                    fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = (int)fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                    invFactorial.push((int)fInv[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            Util::ASSERT(n >= 0);
            if (r < 0 || n < r)
                return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        long long smallInv(int n) {
            return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
        }

        long long normalize(long long x) const {
            long long modVal = modulus();
            x %= modVal;
            if (x < 0)
                x += modVal;
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a + b;
            long long modVal = modulus();
            return v < modVal ? v : v - modVal;
        }

        long long subtract(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a - b;
            long long modVal = modulus();
            return v < 0 ? v + modVal : v;
        }

        long long mult(long long... x) const {
            long long r = 1;
            for (long long i : x)
                r = mult(r, i);
            return r;
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) const {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        long long inv(long long value) const {
            long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
                long long q = g / r;
                g %= r;

                long long temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;

                x -= q * y;

                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            Util::ASSERT(g == 1);
            Util::ASSERT(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());
            return normalize(x);
        }
    };

public:
    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long long modulus() const override {
            return 998244353LL;
        }
    };

    static constexpr long long MODULUS = 998244353LL;
};

class HZSShufflesCards {
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    int n;
    int m;

public:
    void solve() {
        std::cin >> n >> m;
        mod.fInv(n + m);

        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;
        for (int i = 0; p != 0; ++i) {
            p = mod.mult(p, n - i, mod.inv(n + m - i));
            phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
            long long term = mod.mult(mod.ncr(n, k), m + k, mod.inv(k), phaseSize);

            if (k % 2 == 1)
                answer = mod.add(answer, term);
            else
                answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
        }

        std::cout << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
